burry_narrative: Burry Score 43.3 (NEUTRAL, veto_flag=false). FCF yield is deeply negative at -8.8% with ongoing cash burn and capex intensity; however, balance sheet leverage is modest (D/E 0.18, Altman Z 9.54 safe). Heavy insider selling/distribution (-100 MSPR, sell ratio 0.04) and Piotroski score 2 highlight weak current accounting fundamentals, but no T4 veto triggered.
